decisions.rationale: The complete collision report shows 59 informative pairs across three trading dates, but classifies this as L1-C with source_independence_confirmed=false and no independent evidence_sources. The source lineage record keeps AxData provider lineage unconfirmed and FTShare REST underlying provider unconfirmed. The semantic match is not sufficient to establish an independent cross-source mapping; authoritative provider-lineage evidence is required before adjudication.

The report proposes zhb.full.change_pct ≈ 100.00112 × (tencent[31] ÷ tencent[4]) + -0.00043616683 and records R2=1.0 on 12 validation samples across 3 stocks. This remains a statistical lead: the formula candidate is candidate_only, and the target zhb.full.change_pct already has a registered L1 mapping that was revalidated in this report. It is therefore not a new field identity to promote. A derived_relation decision still requires a reviewed, date-aligned CSV replay, verified exact input identities and units, confirmed source-family independence, and a fixed-version authoritative formula definition/reference. Those adjudication artifacts are not present, so no registry change is justified.
